title: Can I Switch Gas Again While Waiting for The 45 Days on My TopCashback Econnex Switch?
body:
Hi all,
I switched my gas through Econnex on TopCashback at the end of August. The terms say I need to stay active for 45 days to get the cashback.
Now I want to switch electricity and gas again through Shopback Energy Comparison (I missed TopCashback deal yesterday). From what I understand, gas doesn't change straight away and only moves at the next meter read or billing cycle.
So my questions are:
1. If I ask for a gas switch now, but the transfer only happens after day 45, will my first cashback still be safe?
2. Does a pending switch count as "leaving" early, or only when the transfer actually happens?
3. Has anyone done a second Econnex switch this close to the first one and still got both cashbacks?
Any experience would help. Thanks!
